visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with three Asian women posing in a modern indoor space with soft globe lighting and lush floral decorations. The primary creator in the foreground, with blonde hair and a black leather jacket, smiles widely and gestures towards the camera while her two companions, wearing beige and blue tops, wave cheerfully. (2) A rapid cut shows a close-up of sushi rolls arranged on a dark ceramic plate with a side of ginger. The setting appears to be a dimly lit, high-end Japanese restaurant. The camera captures the texture of the seaweed and rice before cutting back to the women waving enthusiastically. (3) The scene shifts to a Korean barbecue restaurant where the main creator is seen grilling slices of meat over an open flame. Plates of kimchi and other side dishes are visible on the table. She later eats a piece of meat with concentrated enjoyment, her facial expressions conveying satisfaction. (4) In a bright indoor setting, possibly a studio or home, the three women hold tall, clear bottles filled with a translucent green liquid. They are dressed in athletic crop tops and leggings, posing confidently and clinking their bottles together in a celebratory toast. (5) A man in a striped shirt and glasses appears, sitting at a restaurant table. He dips a piece of focaccia bread into a small dish of sauce. A packet of HEALTH HELPER MAXCUT supplement is shown briefly in his hand before he continues eating with a thumbs-up gesture. (6) Back at a dining table with a spread of meat and mushrooms, the three women hold up small clear supplement cases. The environment is well-lit and vibrant. They are shown taking the pills simultaneously, with text overlays emphasizing fat-burning efficiency. (7) The group is now at a sophisticated restaurant where the GUCCI brand logo is visible, with elegant table settings and wine glasses. They pose together, smiling and gesturing towards the camera, suggesting a cheat meal that is guilt-free due to the supplements they are promoting. (8) The final segment takes place on the busy streets of Myeongdong, Seoul. Four women pose with their arms raised in front of massive digital billboards displaying the main creator's face and the MAXCUT products. The sky is clear, and the lighting is bright natural daylight mixed with neon screens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice begins the narration over an upbeat electronic pop BGM with a steady 120 BPM. A sharp ding sound effect occurs almost immediately. The voice exhibits high pitch variability and a fast speech rate, sounding very friendly and welcoming. (2) As the sushi appears, a percussive clink sound occurs. The BGM remains consistent in volume and texture. The narrator's voice maintains its high energy, describing the experience of eating large meals. Background laughter from her friends is audible but low in intensity. (3) A noticeable whoosh transition SFX triggers a new phase. The acoustic texture shifts slightly as the sizzling of meat on a grill becomes audible in the background. The narrator's speech becomes slightly more rhythmic, matching the upbeat tempo of the electronic music. (4) A pop bubble sound effect marks the mention of small secrets. The BGM swells with a brighter synthesizer texture. The narrator's intensity increases as she introduces the small green water product. The articulation is very clear, like professional broadcasting. (5) A metallic ting sound effect occurs when the man is shown. The background music continues, but the narrator's voice pauses for a second, then resumes with a lower, more conversational tone. Ambient restaurant chatter is faintly heard in the background mix. (6) A sparkle sound effect triggers when the supplement pills are shown. The music's bass rhythm becomes more pronounced. The narrator's voice reaches its highest arousal level, enthusiastically shouting eat it up in Mandarin. The recording quality is studio-clean and very bright. (7) The acoustic environment shifts to an outdoor setting as the narrator mentions Myeongdong. Faint urban traffic and wind noise are detectable. The BGM begins to fade out, replaced by a triumphant stinger. The friends cheer loudly, their voices overlapping with the narration.
